research_result.description: Linear is a project management and issue tracking platform that provides a public GraphQL API, webhooks, a TypeScript SDK, and an official hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agents.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can generate personal API keys under Settings > Account > Security & Access, or configure OAuth applications under Settings > Administration > API. API and MCP access are included on Linear's free tier.

evidence.claim: Linear's public API is built using GraphQL and supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Linear's public API is built using GraphQL. It's the same API we use internally for developing our applications.

evidence.claim: Admins and permitted members can create personal API keys in Account settings.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Admins and permitted Members can create personal API keys from _Settings > Account > Security & Access._

evidence.claim: Linear provides a free plan that includes API, webhook, and MCP access.
Linear hosts an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI clients and agents.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides a standardized interface that allows any compatible AI model or agent to access your Linear data in a simple and secure way.
